overviewParagraph.overviewParagraph: The Golden Designs Dynamic 6-Person Ultra Low EMF FAR Infrared Sauna offers a spacious and rejuvenating wellness retreat right in your home. Designed for indoor use, this sauna is perfect for basements, master baths, or fitness rooms, providing a sanctuary for muscle relaxation, stress relief, and improved circulation. With 16 PureTech™ Ultra Low EMF FAR Infrared Carbon heating panels and crafted from elegant Honey Dark Stain Canadian Hemlock wood, it ensures a safe and luxurious experience. Enjoy the added benefits of chromotherapy lighting and integrated entertainment options, including Bluetooth and MP3 connectivity, for a truly immersive escape.
